newsitem.title: CROATIA: Italian firm invests in Croat Suncani Hvar hotels.
newsitem.headline: Italian firm invests in Croat Suncani Hvar hotels.

text.p: Italian company Gagi Demetrio is to invest three million German marks to rebuild a hotel on the Dalmatian island of Hvar, state news agency HINA reported on Thursday.
The money will be used to renovate the 120-bed, three-star Hotel Faros to prepare it for the arrival of Italian tourists, it quoted Pero Pavisic, director of Suncani Hvar hotel complex as saying.
Company officials were not available to comment.
Suncani Hvar, which is traded regularly on the Zagreb Stock Exchange, closed down one kuna at 66 on Thursday. It is usually described by market participants as having excellent prospects.
Suncani Hvar has nine, mostly three-star, hotels situated on the island and Hina said many of them were now being upgraded.
